content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures asphalt, aggregate and mining equipment; it sells machines rather than mining sand or logistics."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Makes wellheads and pressure control equipment and runs flowback crews, not frac sand supply or proppant logistics."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Road and bridge construction contractor with asphalt and aggregates; a different business from frac sand mining."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Industrial MRO distributor and pump repair for plants; no frac sand or oilfield proppant logistics."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Public infrastructure construction contractor; its materials sales are aggregates for projects, not oilfield sand."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Truckload and intermodal freight for shippers; general freight transport, not proppant logistics for oil and gas."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Telecom, utility and pipeline construction and maintenance contractor; no sand mining or transloading."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Rents and fabricates natural gas compressors; equipment rental rather than sand supply and terminal logistics."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Oil refiner with fuel retail and pipelines; refines crude rather than mining and moving frac sand."},{"label":"C10","good":true,"reason":"Provides proppant storage and handling logistics to oil and gas producers in the Permian, sharing the target's customers and service."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Residential and commercial propane and heating oil distributor; consumer-facing and unrelated to frac sand."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures and leases railcars and highway guardrail; no frac sand mining or proppant logistics."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Drilling and well completion services and tools; oilfield services, not sand supply or transloading."}]}
